name: Matthat
title: Ancestor of Jesus in Luke's genealogy
summary: Matthat is a person mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus in the Gospel of Luke, chapter 3. He is listed as the son of Nathan and the father of Menna. Although little is known about his life, he plays an important role in the messianic lineage that traces Jesus back to King David through David's son Nathan.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus
keyEvents.description: Matthat is listed in Luke's genealogy of Jesus Christ as the son of Nathan and the father of Menna, placing him within the messianic lineage.

keyEvents.title: Part of David's lineage
keyEvents.description: Through his father Nathan, who was a son of David, Matthat is part of the royal lineage that leads to the Messiah.

keyEvents.title: Nathan as David's son
keyEvents.description: Matthat descends from Nathan, one of King David's sons, who is mentioned in 1 Samuel as one of David's children born in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: The Promise of David's Eternal Throne
keyEvents.description: Matthew is part of the fulfillment of God's promise to David that his lineage would endure forever, a promise that points to the Messiah.
